constructors_operate_on: PRIMITIVES ONLY; no constructor may consume another depth-1 constructed coordinate

families.name: primitive_level
families.type_rule: output type, unit, provenance, temporal and flag metadata are inherited unchanged
families.operand_eligibility: all 78 primitives, including the two UNCALIBRATED_SIGNAL levels
families.notes: a representation containing only C0 coordinates is an admissible special case, so the raw-coordinate comparator is NESTED INSIDE the SIR ontology

families.name: first_temporal_derivative
families.operand_eligibility: primitives that are neither uncalibrated nor NUMERICAL_SENSITIVITY_ONLY
families.notes: second derivatives are excluded; no derivative of the target is an explanatory coordinate

families.name: pairwise_product
families.signature: PROD(i,j) with i <= j by frozen inventory index
families.notes: canonical ordering i <= j prevents S7.6 instantiating PROD(i,j) and PROD(j,i) as distinct coordinates; the output carries the compound dimension explicitly

families.name: pairwise_ratio
families.self_ratio_excluded: x_i / x_i is the trivial constant 1
families.notes: those modifications are DIFFERENT coordinate constructions and were not frozen as primary constructors. Numerical support and conditioning of instantiated ratios are handled in S7.6 and S7.11 WITHOUT changing the symbolic coordinate.

families.name: trajectory_relational_derivative
families.self_excluded: D_f f is the trivial constant 1 where defined
families.operand_eligibility: both operands must be eligible for PRIMARY temporal differentiation
families.notes: those variants are related but distinct constructions and require separate explicit qualification if ever studied

symbolic_upper_bounds.note: symbolic upper bounds for audit. NO coordinate instance is enumerated here; instantiation belongs to S7.6.
